question: Where is the constructed measure-part withdrawn after the previous reabsorption?
premises: After withdrawing the previous elements, consciousness withdraws the constructed measure-part.
It withdraws that part into the unconstructed heart.
Even what is beyond all is taken within the unlimited abode.
inference: The process of withdrawal culminates by dissolving constructed measure into an unconstructed and unlimited inner ground.
uncertainties: The subject carrying out the withdrawal remains implicit as consciousness.
plain_english: Then, having withdrawn the constructed part of measurement into the unconstructed heart, it takes even what is beyond all into the unlimited inner abode.
